'''Building''' <!--(Japanese: )--> is a mechanic in {{g|Pokopia}} that allows {{poko|Ditto}} to construct building kits.

==Tips and Tricks==
[[File:Tips and Tricks Pokopia menu icon.png|right|50px]]
{{main|Tips and Tricks}}
{| class="roundtable" style="margin:left; background:#{{pokopia color}}; border:3px solid #{{pokopia color dark}}"

! style="background:#{{pokopia color light}}" | Image
! style="background:#{{pokopia color light}}" | Description
|-
|rowspan=5| Constructing Buildings
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Constructing Buildings.png|200px]]
| Follow these steps to [[File:Build Specialty Icon.png|20px]] {{color|F8970C|build}} a house.
1. Place a {{color|F8970C|building kit}} in the spot where you wish to build.
2. Collect the materials listed in the kit.
3. Gather Pokémon who meet the requirements of the kit.
It will take a little time for the building process to complete.
|-
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Constructing Buildings 2.png|200px]]
| Talk to a Pokémon who meets the requirements of the {{color|F8970C|building kit}} you placed and have them follow you to it. once there, you can ask them to help with the [[File:Build Specialty Icon.png|20px]] {{color|F8970C|building}} process!
|-
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Constructing Buildings 3.png|200px]]
| You can use a different {{color|F8970C|building kit}} to {{color|F8970C|remodel}} an existing house or {{color|F8970C|Pokémon Center}} into a whole new house with all of the same furniture inside. However, you cannot turn a large house into a smaller one.
|-
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Constructing Buildings 4.png|200px]]
| To demolish a house, place a {{color|F8970C|demolition kit}} in front of the house, then gather Pokémon to help with the {{color|F8970C|demolition}}.
|-
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Constructing Buildings 5.png|200px]]
| To relocate a house, place a {{color|F8970C|relocation kit}} in front of the house, then gather Pokémon to help with the {{color|F8970C|relocation preparations}}. Once preparations are complete, place the kit in a new spot, then gather Pokémon to help with the {{color|F8970C|relocation}}.
|-
| Building Underwater
| [[File:Pokopia Tips Building Underwater.png|200px]]
| If you use a {{color|F8970C|building kit}} while using Dive, you can [[File:Build Specialty Icon.png|20px]] {{color|F8970C|build}} floating structures in or on the water. (Certain structures can't be [[File:Build Specialty Icon.png|20px]] {{color|F8970C|built}} in water.)
|}
